messages:
Elena M.: heads-up: Azure Turkey (turkeywest) marketplace + H100 dedicated offering request from Kale Systems. need quota numbers, compliance checklist for local data residency, and hardware entitlement. can we triage?
Yusuf A. (Azure): Azure partner ops here. we can open marketplace onboarding but need SKU model (SaaS vs VMOffer), expected VM counts, and any ARM64 specifics. also regulatory note for Turkey: local invoicing required.
Tom B.: sales note: three pilot customers (fintech, retail, gov analytics). start with 3 H100 nodes, burst to 6. target 120 req/s @ 12k tokens.
Rana P.: legal/compliance: local privacy requirements + invoice routing. need to confirm whether logs/telemetry stay in-region. if not, customers will want explicit consent.
Kale-SI: integration ask: runbook for VPN and private link, plus terraform module. we prefer AMI/VMOffer model for ease of customer deployment.
NVIDIA-partner-bot: H100 inventory in MEA is limited; partner discount needs forecast commit and signed engagement. LOI template can be shared.
marketplace-bot: terraform snippet requested. paste below: 
```
module "azure-marketplace-turkey" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/modules/azure/marketplace.git//region"
  region = "turkeywest"
  vm_sku = "Standard_H100-80gb"
  dedicated_count = 3
  marketplace_type = "vmoffer"
}
```
Elena M.: Yusuf, can you confirm marketplace flow and whether Turkey needs local tax docs attached to the listing?
Yusuf A. (Azure): yes, local tax registration required for paid offers. I'll send the marketplace checklist link and assigned partner rep.
Tom B.: pricing: we'll publish USD MSRP with a Turkey-adjusted price later. preparing MSRP draft now.
Rana P.: I'll draft a short addendum about telemetry and invoices. ETA Wed EOD.
Kale-SI: propose partner sync Thu 11:00 TRT to walk runbook and infra tasks.
Elena M.: action items: (1) Yusuf  share marketplace checklist + contact (24h). (2) Tom  MSRP draft (48h). (3) Rana  draft addendum (Wed EOD). (4) Kale  prepare onboarding template (Thu). (5) NVIDIA  LOI template and inventory note.
NVIDIA-partner-bot: LOI template sent to Elena. inventory update expected in 3 business days.
Elena M.: thanks team  will send calendar invite and drop checklist when Yusuf posts it. tagging @here for visibility :turkey:
file_notes: Coordination thread for Azure Turkey (turkeywest) marketplace + NVIDIA H100 dedicated capacity; includes terraform snippet and action items
